notes: Food and food ingredients: 3.0% statewide (1.75% state, 1.0% local option, 0.25% county option).
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).

gaps: Groceries are taxed at a reduced combined rate in Utah; this file gives the general rate.
